summary: A monthly (first Wednesday) science talk and social salon at The Mule/Devil's Foot Beverage in Asheville, run under its own brand independent of the venue, with a mission to 'cultivate curiosity and build community.' It has its own website, mailing list, Instagram, and Facebook group, and has been running since at least 2022, suggesting a returning core audience rather than a one-off lecture series.

evidence.note: Listings describe it as a recurring monthly bar meetup explicitly aimed at 'cultivating curiosity and community', with attendees framed as 'old friends' and 'new ones' who return.

Dedicated organizational website (separate from the venue) states the mission is to build community, and lists a mailing list signup, Instagram (@big_asheville_science_salon), and a Facebook group for the salon.
A listing from December 2022 shows the salon has been running for several years under the same name and format, not a new one-off series.

Search results show ongoing listings across multiple calendars (Mountain Xpress, Devil's Foot Beverage's own site, avlgo.com, meetdaisy.co) through at least October 2026, consistent with a long-running monthly institution rather than a single business class.
